Chesapeake Bay from Sandy Point to North Beach-
657 AM EST Mon Nov 9 2026

...SMALL CRAFT ADVISORY IN EFFECT THROUGH THIS EVENING...

.TODAY...NW winds 20 kt with gusts to 30 kt. Waves 3 ft. 
.TONIGHT...NW winds 10 to 15 kt. Gusts up to 20 kt in the evening.
Waves 1 to 2 ft. 
.TUE...SW winds 5 to 10 kt. Waves 1 ft. 
.TUE NIGHT...W winds 5 to 10 kt. Waves 1 ft. 
.WED...W winds 5 kt. Waves less than 1 ft. 
.WED NIGHT...SE winds 5 to 10 kt. Waves 1 ft. 
.THU...E winds 10 to 15 kt...becoming N 20 to 25 kt after midnight.
Waves 1 to 2 ft...building to 3 ft after midnight. Rain likely in
the afternoon. A chance of rain in the evening, then rain likely
after midnight. 
.FRI...N winds 25 to 30 kt. Waves 3 ft. Rain likely through the day,
then a chance of rain in the evening.
